title: No test pins sail get's past-the-end error on each backend
body:
`sail get` with a position past the end fails with `position {last} was asked for and the input holds {n} records`. Each of the three backends builds that message separately in `get.rs`: Indexed, Stream and Memory. No test in `sail/tests/cli.rs` matches it, so a backend whose wording or count drifts passes every test.

## Proposal

One `cli.rs` test per backend that runs `get` with a position past the end of a fixture. Each test checks the exit code and the exact stderr line, including the record count.
close_reason: Landed in d9d482d on dev: a_position_past_the_end_fails_the_same_way_on_every_backend in sail/tests/cli.rs.
